messages:
oliver: quick usability review of the scorecard + approval flow mock. dropped frames in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (scorecard, compact-diff, approval-modal)
sana: good stuff. immediate thought: approval CTA label reads 'Approve' but when you hover the tooltip it says 'Approve and merge changes' which feels inconsistent. we should standardize copy so users know whether approvals trigger downstream actions.
priya: +1. also the primary/secondary button order in the modal is inverted on mobile because of our stack ordering. primary action should stay on the right for desktop and left for mobile? that flips mental model. we should pick one pattern.
marcus: from QA: keyboard trap in the compact-diff. when expanding a diff row with Enter, focus lands inside the diff content but there is no clear way to jump to the next row without tabbing a lot. suggest roving tabindex for rows and Enter to toggle expansion. add shortcut `J`/`K` to move between rows for power users.
design-bot: accessibility scan: missing focus-visible style on diff expansion, color contrast fail in low-contrast score tags, no aria-live for approval confirmation. See /reports/scan-1849001234.pdf
priya: for confirmation we should avoid modals for one-click approves. maybe a small inline banner with undo for 5s? but for bulk approvals we do need a confirmation modal with required reason field.
oliver: good point. single approvals = inline toast + undo; bulk approvals = modal with reason (required) and 'Apply to all matched' checkbox. copy suggestion for modal header: 'Confirm bulk approval'.
sana: copy nit for scorecard metrics: the label 'Delta' is ambiguous to product folks. maybe use 'Score change' or 'Difference'. 'Delta' is fine for engineers but we want clarity.
marcus: also found a visual regression where compact-diff code block loses syntax highlighting on high-contrast mode. need to ensure tokens map to high-contrast theme.
priya: small UX wrinkle: when an eval run returns >100 diffs, pagination + filters are hidden under a 'More' dropdown which is too nested. propose persistent filter bar that stays pinned.
oliver: agreed. pinned filter bar + quick actions (bulk select, export CSV) makes sense. export should surface CSV and JSON options.
design-bot: suggestion: add aria-describedby="reason-help" on the approval modal reason input with text 'Explain why these prompts should be approved (shown in audit logs)'.
marcus: QA request: add audit hint to copy: anywhere we say 'Approve' append small gray '— recorded in audit log' text or tooltip. helps customer support triage.
sana: keyboard shortcut mapping proposal: `Shift+A` = open bulk approve modal, `U` = undo last approve (if still within undo window), `F` = focus filter bar. include in the keyboard help modal.
priya: copy proposals for inline undo toast: 'Approved — Undo' and for modal confirm button: 'Confirm and Approve'. for single approve button keep 'Approve'.
oliver: design decision: keep primary CTA for single approve as 'Approve' and for modal primary as 'Confirm and Approve' to emphasize bulk nature. we'll document in the component library.
marcus: filing follow-ups: #UX-4120 pin filter bar, #UX-4121 bulk-approve-modal, #FE-712 fix keyboard roving, #QA-221 add high-contrast theme tokens.
priya: will update Figma with tooltip copy and modal layout. added comments on the scorecard frame.
design-bot: added checklist items to tickets: focus-visible, aria-live, audit-copy, keyboard-shortcuts.
oliver: thanks everyone. i'll batch these into two dev stories (single vs bulk flows) and tag eng-frontend. ping me if you want to pair on keyboard behavior. :thumbsup:
sana: :thumbsup:
priya: pairing in the morning if needed.
marcus: running a smoke test on the current build, will report if anything else pops up.
qa-bot: automated test run queued: run/9843. report will post in #eng-qa when complete.
oliver: closing thread for now — will reopen if QA flags critical regressions.
